instruction: Access the Tasks view in Thunderbird. Open the task management interface where you can create and organize to-do items.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Tasks tab in Thunderbird. Similar to original task but targets Tasks view instead of About Profiles. Uses accessibility tree to verify the Tasks tab is open.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same app, same interaction pattern (open tab), similar complexity
